metadata.description: A Claude Code plugin marketplace for job-search workflows and writing style.

plugins.name: job-search
plugins.description: Job search workflow — evaluates job fit, screens salary and title preferences, tailors CVs and cover letters, and preps interviews.

plugins.name: communication-style
plugins.description: A direct, plain-spoken, Australian-English writing style for anything Claude drafts — chat, email, Slack, tickets, docs.

plugins.name: document-design
plugins.description: A reusable HTML document design system for CVs, one-pagers and short reports, with print-to-PDF rules.
